name: WASP-7
description: Star of 6,400 K, 162 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-7 b crosses WASP-7 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Southworth et al. 2011.

quotes.title: WASP-7
quotes.card: WASP-7, also identified as HD 197286, is a type F star located about 527 light-years away in the constellation Microscopium.
quotes.introduction: This star is a little larger and about 28% more massive than the Sun and is also brighter and hotter.
